# PLAN-170 C1 fixture. Each requirement is guarded by an environment marker (or none).
# Expected outcomes are authored from PEP 508 semantics (deterministic — the spec, not a
# native-resolver capture). The test evaluates these against two declared descriptors.

# marker-true shape + python_version (version-valued, routes through pep440).
pkg-pyver==1.0.0 ; python_version >= "3.8"

# marker-false shape + sys_platform (string equality).
pkg-plat==1.0.0 ; sys_platform == "win32"

# marker-unbound shape: platform_machine is not bound by either descriptor.
pkg-unbound==1.0.0 ; platform_machine == "x86_64"

# boolean structure: and / or / parentheses.
pkg-bool==1.0.0 ; (python_version >= "3.8" and sys_platform == "linux") or os_name == "nt"

# the `in` membership operator (substring).
pkg-in==1.0.0 ; "linux" in sys_platform

# python_full_version (version-valued, X.Y.Z).
pkg-full==1.0.0 ; python_full_version >= "3.11.0"

# reversed orientation: literal on the left, version variable on the right.
pkg-reversed==1.0.0 ; "3.8" <= python_version

# no marker → always selected.
pkg-nomarker==1.0.0
